summary: WP-004 PASS. SortManagerTest is thorough, well-structured, and follows all project testing conventions.

Test isolation: setUp/tearDown save/restore $_GET via $this->originalGet — correct and consistent with the project's other test classes. Each test creates a fresh DataGrid, ensuring SortManager starts with $resolved=false for clean state.

Coverage breadth: All 8 required scenarios are implemented — Native ASC/DESC, Callback ASC/DESC (with static closures preventing $this capture), Manual no-op, no-sort-column no-op (full $_GET=[] clear), MergedRow preservation, and numeric sort.

MergedRow preservation test: Insertion order [Charlie@0, MergedRow@1, Alice@2, Bob@3]. After ASC sort, StandardRow positions {0,2,3} receive {Alice,Bob,Charlie}; MergedRow holds position 1. All 7 assertions are correct against the partition/reassemble algorithm.

Numeric sort test: test inputs '10','9','100' trigger the is_numeric()+float spaceship path in compareValues(). Expected result [9,10,100] correctly distinguishes numeric from lexicographic (which would give [10,100,9]). The inline comment documents this non-obvious distinction.
Callback DESC test: uses DataGridInterface::SORT_DESC constant (not a raw string), which is the correct way to set direction in tests. Static closures used for callbacks.
49 assertions across 8 tests. No structural, security, or maintainability concerns.
